maintenance_led.reason: Sells new consumer products (OXO housewares, Hydro Flask, hair tools, humidifiers) to retailers and consumers; first-time purchases, not servicing.

publicly_funded.reason: Revenue comes from retailers and consumers buying housewares, beauty and wellness products, not government.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly organically through product innovation and brand investment; acquisitions occasional, and it is now focusing on stabilizing existing brands.

mission_critical.reason: Retailers and consumers can easily switch among competing housewares, hair care, and wellness brands; no qualification or downtime.
